question: In a certain code language, ‘DISPUTE' is written as 'SID16ETU'. How will 'FEATURE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First three and last three letters ⇒ Written diagonally.
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ Position value according to the English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• ‘DISPUTE' is written as 'SIDI6ETU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c540bbe729c5b9ff447b625c75c69a8ce76f0a3480bdbdd8db6d67ef417725.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'FEATURE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b95e2f47134d014ce49cc3a99065e050294f15f6f448bc0c3bc55b5a1e6fe88a.png] 

Hence, **"AEF20ERU**" is the correct answer.
